messages.text: Can Engineering use Cursor for internal IDE work? Same problem as the last coding-assistant request: we need something in the editor, not a chat tab.

Org bar is unchanged: no customer PII in prompts, company SSO only, prompt logs kept 6 months for Legal, internal employees only, named owner. Cursor is a code tool so we also need a signed DPA and written proof they do not train on or keep our code.
Anysphere DPA is signed (file PROC-DPA-CURSOR-2026-05). Training opt-out is in the DPA annex: they do not train on customer code and do not retain prompts after the session. SSO via our IdP is on.

Legal signs Cursor for Engineering, owner Maya Okonkwo, internal IDE use only. Conditions: no customer PII in prompts; company SSO; 6-month prompt audit; Anysphere DPA on file; no-training-on-code annex. This DPA does not cover any other vendor.
